payload.tension: The passage states 1 Chronicles 10:11–14 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it is locally described; the wording centers on “Also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
